  data_list: NA

# Species Critical Habitat PBFs

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Get the data
df <- params$data_list[[1]]

# 2. DATA TRANSFORMATION
# We want one row per Species_full. 
# Inside the PBF column, we will construct the Category + Bulleted List string.
formatted_df <- df %>%
  group_by(Species_full, PBF_category) %>%
  # Create a bulleted list for each category
summarise(
      category_block = if(all(PBF_category == "")) {
        # CASE A: No Category exists - just the bullets
        paste0("  • ", PBF, collapse = "\n")
      } else {
        # CASE B: Category exists - Header + Colon + Bullets
        paste0(PBF_category, ":\n", 
               paste0("  • ", PBF, collapse = "\n"))
      },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species_full) %>%
  # Combine all categories for that species into one big text block
  summarise(
    PBF_Final_List = paste(category_block, collapse = "\n\n"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Create the flextable
ft <- flextable(formatted_df)

# 4. Formatting
ft <- theme_vanilla(ft)
ft <- width(ft, j = 1, width = 1.5)
ft <- width(ft, j = 2, width = 5.0)

# Set Headers
ft <- set_header_labels(ft, 
    Species_full = "Species/ESU/DPS", 
    PBF_Final_List = "Physical or Biological Features"
)

# Align text to top so long lists look right
ft <- valign(ft, valign = "top", part = "all")

# Optional: Add borders between species to make the list readable
ft <- border_inner_h(ft, border = officer::fp_border(color="gray80", width = 1))

# 5. Display
ft
